events.title: Demo Patch 2: A Tutorial, Beards, and a Week of Fixes
events.summary: 🎓 A guided first run New players were leaving within five minutes, so the demo now walks you through its first run properly. Ten steps that hand you the game one piece at a time: recruit two Berserkers, watch your synergy climb, take a Healer, buy gear, equip it, pick a fightEverything you are not meant to touch yet is dimmed, and the thing you are meant to click is litThe Commander narrates it, typing as he goes, with a blinking caret and a pause at every full stop ⌨️It fires once per save slot

events.title: Demo Patch 1: Save Protection and a Stack of Fixes
events.summary: First patch since the demo went out 😁. Most of this came from playing it and finding things that had been broken for weeks without anyone noticing.SavesFixed a bug where every exported build lost all equipped items and inventory on load. The game looks up items by scanning a folder, and an exported build stores those files under a different extension, so the lookup found nothing.
